fusions.name: Link by Link
fusions.desc: Casts the hooked head out on its links for 7 damage, then on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Grapple Haul
fusions.desc: Hooks the target and hauls you up to 7 tiles onto it, dealing 13 damage, slowing it by 30% for 3 seconds and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Reeled In
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Held at Haft's Length
fusions.desc: Your armour is 10% higher against enemies carrying your afflictions.
